audio.type: numpy.ndarray when use_tensor=False; torch.Tensor when use_tensor=True
audio.caller_owns: Decoding, resampling and supplying nonempty finite audio.
audio.quantization: use_tensor=False clips to [-1,1], converts float32 to int16 and back; use_tensor=True skips this quantization.

outputs.type: CPU numpy.ndarray when use_tensor=False; torch.Tensor on the model device when use_tensor=True
outputs.normalization: Each public embedding method applies L2 normalization.
outputs.text_pooling: RoBERTa pooler_output (transformed first token) passes through CLAP text projection, then L2 normalization.
outputs.audio_pooling: HTSAT audio embedding passes through CLAP audio projection, then L2 normalization.
outputs.native_scores: These methods return embeddings, not probabilities or genre decisions.

adapter.windowing: Caller splits each track into consecutive non-overlapping 480000-sample windows and appends a final window aligned to the track end when the remainder is shorter, mirroring the upstream audio_infer window layout. Audio shorter than one window is submitted whole for upstream repeatpad.
adapter.pooling: Native per-window L2-normalized embeddings, mean over a track's windows, final L2 normalization.
